## 1. Acceptance

These terms apply to the use of the website [domain] (the "site"), operated by Cedrik Ferland, residential real estate broker, REMAX Privilège, real estate agency. By using the site, you accept these terms.

## 2. Purpose of the site

The site presents the residential real estate brokerage services of Cedrik Ferland, holder of a licence issued by the Organisme d'autoréglementation du courtage immobilier du Québec (OACIQ), licence no. [number].

The content of the site is provided for information only. It is not legal, financial or tax advice, nor advice suited to your situation. Using the site or sending a form does not create a brokerage relationship. Such a relationship begins with the signing of a brokerage contract.

## 3. Properties shown

The properties shown on the site are covered by a brokerage contract in effect. The information about them is provided as a guide and may change without notice. Links to detailed listings lead to the REMAX website, which has its own terms of use.

## 4. Valuations and calculators

A valuation obtained through the site is an opinion of market value prepared by a real estate broker. It is not an appraisal by a chartered appraiser. Calculator results are estimates and do not replace the advice of a financial institution.

A valuation request is free and carries no obligation.

## 5. Intellectual property

The texts, photos and other content of the site belong to Cedrik Ferland or to their respective owners. The REMAX marks are the property of their owners and are used under licence. Any reproduction without written permission is prohibited.

You agree not to use the site for illegal purposes, not to send false information or information belonging to another person, and not to interfere with its operation, including by sending forms automatically.

## 7. External links

The site contains links to third-party sites. We have no control over those sites and are not responsible for their content.

## 8. Limitation of liability

We make reasonable efforts to keep the content of the site accurate and up to date, without guaranteeing that it is complete or free of errors. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damages arising from the use of the site or the inability to use it.

## 9. Personal information

How your personal information is handled is described in our [privacy policy](/en/privacy/).

We may change these terms. The version in effect is published on this page, with the date it was last updated.

## 11. Governing law
